task.description:
Develop requirement ES-01 into a full-fledged specification by adding acceptance criteria, cross-references, and edge-case constraints.

ES-01 — Append event (MUST, Stage 1):

> The platform SHALL append a typed, immutable event record to the event log for a given process instance. Each event carries: `event_id` (UUID v4), `instance_id`, `event_type`, `payload` (JSON), `actor_id`, and `created_at` (UTC timestamp with microsecond precision).

Your task:
1. Add an **Acceptance Criteria** subsection to ES-01 in `docs/BPM_Platform_Functional_Requirements.md`. Include at least one verifiable statement per field in the event record (event_id, instance_id, event_type, payload, actor_id, created_at), plus:
   - Immutability: once appended, an event MUST NOT be modifiable
   - The append operation MUST fail with a specific error if the `instance_id` does not exist
   - `created_at` precision requirements (microseconds → behaviour under concurrent appends within the same microsecond)
   - HTTP response shape on success (status code, returned fields)
2. Add a **See:** cross-reference line referencing: ES-03 (idempotency governs deduplication), ES-05 (type registry validates payload before append), DB-03 (transactional guarantee).
3. Add an **Edge cases** note covering: what happens when payload is null vs empty object; whether actor_id may be null; maximum payload size (reference NFR-05).

Do NOT change the existing description text of ES-01. Only ADD content beneath it.
Do NOT touch any other requirement in the document.

Important: ES-01 defines the canonical event structure that ALL downstream requirements reference. Precision here prevents cascade rework later.
acceptance_criteria: ES-01 has an 'Acceptance Criteria' subsection with at least 6 verifiable statements
Every field in the event record (event_id, instance_id, event_type, payload, actor_id, created_at) has at least one testable criterion
NFR-05 (8 KB page size / 4 KB payload side-table) is referenced in the edge cases
Cross-references to ES-03, ES-05, DB-03 are present
No vague language (reasonably, appropriately, as needed) appears in the added text
No existing description prose is altered
